properties.description: Policy initiative for Azure Container Apps FedRAMP High compliance. Bundles transmission confidentiality (SC-8/SC-13), boundary protection (SC-7), authentication (IA-2), encryption-at-rest (SC-28), and audit generation (AU-12) policies. Workloads hosting federal data MUST enforce all bundled controls.
